class.name: WasmScript
class.brief_description: A Script resource backed by a WebAssembly (WASM) module.
class.description:
[WasmScript] represents a script authored in WAT (WebAssembly Text Format) with the [code].wscript[/code] extension. At import time the WAT source is compiled to a [code].wasm[/code] binary using [code]wat2wasm[/code] from the WABT toolchain. At runtime the binary is loaded and instantiated via the WAMR interpreter, providing one isolated WASM module instance per [Object].
[b]Host bindings available to WASM:[/b] [codeblock] ;; Print a UTF-8 string to Godot output (import "godot" "godot_print" (func $godot_print (param i32 i32))) [/codeblock]
[b]Lifecycle exports called by the engine:[/b] - [code]gd_ready(self: i32)[/code] – invoked on [constant Node.NOTIFICATION_READY]. - [code]gd_process(self: i32, delta: f32)[/code] – call from a GDScript [code]_process[/code] method.
[b]Note:[/b] WAMR must be present in [code]thirdparty/wamr/[/code] for runtime execution. See [code]modules/wasm/README.md[/code] for setup instructions.

members.member: Path to the compiled [code].wasm[/code] binary in the import cache ([code].import/[/code]). Set automatically by [ResourceImporterWasm] at import time.
